The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The unit tests only pin the source; only AutoCAD's live UCS turns a typed point, and only the real R1 frame and auto-placement show where the tag lands.
not_automated: The tag's direction (dynamic grip rotation) and the exact slide chosen by auto-placement are recorded, not asserted.
The Object option (picking real beam or wall lines) and the rubber band from the first pick are not driven (Codex look for the rubber band).
